methodology: Three interleaved rounds, same NAS/SSD, one bounded synthetic client at a time; no production data/media mounts; timings include native authorization/source/guard/file checks

supplementary_mature_study.study: Existing data after full trial23 workload and natural automatic statistics; no reseed or manual ANALYZE

preserved_preliminary_wave.reason: After diagnostic profiling, final source includes adapter 0.1.2, narrower PG queries, setup batching and one-time scope serialization. CPU7 idle earlier fell to 7-9%; all final clients uniformly use CPUs0-7. No preliminary timings are mixed into final medians

preserved_protocol_preliminary_wave.reason: Preserved complete trial11 and first three trial12 runs before final protocol/scope optimization

core_context: Formal lifecycle baseline captured after separately authorized TS250 release; benchmark baseline remains exact e1/Q14, candidate is isolated and not deployed
scope_limits: Synthetic flat complete groups; activated facts/context features but not all automatic history/model workloads
SourceAuthority owner transport is synthetic in-process, with native validation/barrier/guard; excludes real Core/Platform TLS latency
Knowledge HTTP uses real ASGI entry in-container; excludes external TLS/network latency
Fresh application means a new object and Store lifecycle, not OS/PG physical cold cache
Shared NAS background load varies; all three formal rounds are retained
